name: Houndstone
description: Houndstone, the Ghost Dog Pokémon, and the evolved form of Greavard. A Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
